description:
Soldier Boy finds himself locked in a fierce battle against The Seven with the all-new crossover bundle: The Boys x Rainbow Six Siege. Featuring Blackbeard as Soldier Boy.
Brought to you by Vought+, experience it in-game or at rainbow6.com/ingameitems.

About Rainbow Six Siege:
Rainbow Six Siege is an exciting, new approach to the first-person shooter experience that puts tactical combat and masterful destruction at the center of the action. Lead your team of unique operators through tense and thrilling combat scenarios, and achieve victory through smart preparation and strategic improvisation. Rainbow Six Siege is available now on Xbox, PlayStation® and PC.

description:
Welcome to Trackmania — the unique racing game that combines precision and creativity. 

Trackmania® offers a unique, easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay experience with a wide diversity of tracks across five stunning environment (Red Island, Blue Bay, Green Coast, White Shore, and Stadium) along with regular content updates and live events:
- Face new racing challenges with Weekly Shorts and Weekly Grands, a new season every three months, and more player-made tracks featured in the “Track of the Day” selection.
- Compete online in Daily and Weekly Cups, Grand Enduro races, as well as in community-driven and worldwide esports events.


#Ubisoft #Trackmania
